# Isaiah Chapter 51 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 23 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Look to Abraham; comfort for Zion; Rahab cut in pieces; awake; cup of staggering removed*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Comfort for Zion:** Look to Abraham; comfort for Zion; Rahab cut in pieces; awake; cup of staggering removed. The key message for modern readers: "Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD"

*-- PNEUMA*
